pullRequest.title: Repair operational workflows and validate sync with real backend journeys
pullRequest.body:
Operational entry mixed process causes with observed quality results, several screens counted assets inconsistently, and one failed sync group could hold up unrelated changes. This branch repairs those shared application paths, adds qualified reports and open-by-default lists in 15-row increments, and improves maintenance intake, planned work and phone layouts.

Retained catalogue, legacy-template and existing-job edits are bound to their originating account. Native rows and immutable commands commit together; the backend rechecks identity, authority, project and version and blocks the old direct-write bypass. Another account cannot send, replace or acknowledge pending work. Unknown-origin legacy edits remain saved for review. Independent sync groups continue after another group fails; dependent work stays local and partial progress is reported honestly. Obsolete account listeners and delayed cleanup are fenced against session changes.

Business repairs preserve the generated RED-preparation request's identity and required decoder fields, reject malformed compliance priorities before writes, and prevent copied Inner Cover assignments from authorizing custody over another installed cover. Backend-produced RED records are checked by Dart readers. Both RED routes and refusal/no-write cases are covered through real Firestore transactions. Burner/directive chronology guards reject backwards or inconsistent acknowledgements without silently changing event times.

Catalogue mutations now distinguish strict new authorship from readable historical creator evidence. Existing absent/null attribution remains immutable; reader-normalized padded identities can be edited without replacing the raw historical creator text. The equivalent legacy-template path retains exact original text, null values and omitted fields. Actual native/server baselines constrain client validation. Every current editor still needs complete, actor-bound attribution; identity changes, invalid catalogue blanks and unauthorized template deletion remain rejected. Request fingerprints and exact accepted replay remain intact.

Execution work updates now preserve omitted optional fields while retaining explicit null clearing. Storage, audit and receipt derive from the same exact update; pinned fields retain their stored representations. Required work fields, protected assignment metadata, equipment identity and exact replay remain enforced. The 36 new regressions reproduced 14 failures before repair; all 257 retained-mutation tests now pass.

Reclaimed workflow commands aborted before their first recorded failure now retain a retry schedule. Existing and explicitly supplied future holds take precedence; otherwise cleanup uses the exact UTC claim timestamp. Lease ownership, origin account, immutable payload, accepted receipts and attempt budgets remain protected. This change does not bulk-reschedule historical uncertain commands.

Inner Cover entry, history and register reports use **dd-MM-yyyy**, with time where relevant. Invalid/future physical dates remain visible for correction. Failed or incomplete history retains qualified saved evidence instead of appearing empty. Compact ticket headers retain criticality, agency progress, pending sync and exceptional workflow indicators, wrapping for larger text. Duplicate Control-screen shortcuts were removed; all five destination cards and callbacks remain. Plant condition recovery/counting and compact summary improvements are also included; production readback and client-update boundaries are recorded separately.

CI retains its existing checks and requires **seven Android business journeys** against isolated Auth/Functions/Firestore emulators, with canonical readbacks and strict completion markers. Coverage includes abnormality entry, separate-process recovery, planned publication through closure, four-case maintenance/Quality adjudication, burner survey/directive follow-through and the two-process account-ownership recovery pair. Five diagnostic/fixture-dependent probes remain explicitly excluded.

Play preparation adds public privacy, support and account-deletion request pages plus in-app access before sign-in/approval and from More. External actions create user-reviewed email/browser requests with copyable fallbacks and preserve saved work. The static site is live; request fulfillment remains an owner-operated procedure, not an automated erasure claim.

Release preparation admits a bounded next-candidate protocol with fresh source-specific authority, preserves historical Build28/29 controls, corrects the Android CI job identity, and verifies an explicit App Check client choice before version reservation, during construction and against archived package evidence. Private custody binds allocation baseline, committed approval and final artifact without a self-hash cycle or weakening exact-main finalization. New refusal tests run in the existing CI suite. No next build number, approval record or live backend change is created by this source preparation.
### Current validation

Current source revision: **e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f**. The fresh bot review reports no major issues on this exact head (comment5857983988). All four CodeQL jobs, backend tests, Rules/emulator tests and Android packaging have passed; full Flutter and Android business-journey jobs remain running. The previous head `5c26f009` passed all four CodeQL jobs, including Java/Kotlin compilation and method-body extraction after CMake/Ninja provisioning. These are not substituted for the new head's checks.

- Latest approval-boundary repairs: **26/26** focused source-authority controls and **23/23** App Check tests passed. The latter exercises **320 invalid inputs** across both approval identity fields and **eleven genuine identity pairs**, through actual repository preflight with recomputed hashes. Historical wording cannot become fresh authority through case, invisible characters or punctuation; formatting inside/wrapping known placeholder identities, including composed/decomposed combining marks, is rejected without rewriting retained evidence. Independent scoped reviews are clean. All reported repair threads are resolved with linked evidence; fresh bot review is requested.
- The complete `test:distribution-readback-custody` suite passed **569/569** in CI at `718d5da0`, closing the previously incomplete local historical run. Additional repair regressions remain in the same CI command; old results do not establish new-head acceptance.
- Shared-client local baseline: full Flutter **4,107 passed, one existing skip**, analysis clean; focused help/design/deferral **42/42**; canonical audit **153/153**, including **434 retained hash pointers**. CI reruns the complete source gates and seven required Android business journeys on the new head.
- Business-source evidence at `c76cfa38`: Functions build/inventories and **2,735 host tests across 83 suites** passed; **291 emulator-only tests across 25 suites** explicitly skipped in the host run. Separate authenticated HTTP **7/7**, Rules **247/247**, and all seven required isolated Android business journeys passed.
- Private artifact custody: **94 distinct cases** passed across the combined run and one bounded positive-fixture retry. No cloud requests occurred in those synthetic tests.
- Public support pages passed layout checks and anonymous HTTPS source-byte readback. Signed-device email/browser handling and actual Play-delivered acceptance remain pending.
- Live GitHub readback confirms five required Actions checks and strict protection after aligning the obsolete Android context to the current shell-plus-business job; all other protections were preserved. Secret-scanning and Dependabot open-alert inventories were empty at the latest readback.

### Release boundary

The PR is ready for review following the clean current-head bot and independent reviews. Merge remains conditional on every required exact-head check passing. The owner has requested the next signed candidate and freshly confirmed the coordinated all-users pause, including older/offline phones. This records that current operational decision; it does not claim backend deployment, build allocation or a signed artifact.

Browser access has recovered. Live Play inspection found no uploaded bundles or releases and an available internal-test route. The public production track separately requires 12 continuously opted-in closed testers for 14 days. The privacy-policy URL is saved for review, and a separate owner-only initial acceptance list is selected and persisted; the previous list is preserved. Play's app-signing SHA-256 was directly read back from its signing-key control and matches the original signer. The representative phone is connected with production Build29; no app data was cleared or changed by these checks.

After accepted source and exact merged-main CI, execution still requires real source-specific backend authority, measured Functions/Rules before/after evidence, fresh candidate policy/ledger/approvals, protected signing and independent artifact custody. Preserve existing IAM and runtime limits. The bounded deployment route must not invoke a scheduler manually or use the generic legacy IAM-finalization phases. A pristine measured runtime checkout is required before deployment tooling installation.

Actual Play-delivered in-place acceptance must account for saved work before and after upgrade, retaining original actor/envelope evidence. A review-only pending item is not forced to zero or discarded. A matching certificate, CI package or ADB installation is not Play-delivery proof. Internal candidate testing and broader/public distribution remain distinct.

Review evidence: [coordinated release plan](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/PLAY_COORDINATED_RELEASE_PLAN_2026_09_27.md), [Play readiness](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/PLAY_DISTRIBUTION_READINESS_2026_09_27.md), [public support validation](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/PLAY_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_VALIDATION_2026_09_27.md), [data-handling inventory](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/PLAY_DATA_HANDLING_INVENTORY_2026_09_27.md), [execution storage/receipt parity](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/EXECUTION_WORK_RECEIPT_PARITY_2026_09_27.md), [CF01 ownership](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/CF01_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION_2026_09_27.md), and [CI business journeys](https://github.com/abhishekvatsa/crm3_baf_ops/blob/e64184862549eea797b19225dafed351d0cb1c0f/docs/CI_BUSINESS_JOURNEYS.md).
